# 以之为生与世系使关系项直接相关：一类读法提供的两种 related / Living on and descent relate relata directly: two readings of related that the one-kind reading supplies

## 主张 Claim

在依存网的逐步读法上，保留 living（活跃且不侵蚀），在交互之外加入两种只有一类关系项的读法才有的关系。以之为生：一个形成在某步汲取一个关系项、并以正需要依存于它（LivesOn）；这样的事件与该关系项的事件相关（sustenance）。它与交互一样不是免费的：它需要实际的汲取与能落空的依存；在 Dependent 之下，活跃的形成以之为生的关系项在该步作为条件而在（LivesOn.stands），该关系项体现时也在该步活跃（LivesOn.active）。两者都不必：吃者可以以一个休眠时仍作为条件而在的关系项为生，以之为生使它们连通而交互不连通（Drowsy.drowsy）。它使只依存于对方的蜂与花连通（Mutualism.apart_sustenance_connected），而共同参与与交互都不连通它们。在 N_rel 之下，珍视一个以某关系项为生的事件，就珍视该关系项的每个活的事件，反之亦然（living_on_reaches、lived_on_reaches）：珍视狐的进食，就到达兔的活。世系：一个关系项从一个形成而来，当后者参与某步、在该步给予它，而它跨该步开始作为条件而在（Descends）；不参与的形成的给予项不进入任何水平，不造成世系（Unrelated.unrelated、Brood.not_descends）；世系使两个关系项的每个事件相关（descent）。在平衡且只有活跃形成给予的流中，生起的体现关系项从在该步活跃的另一个形成而来（Embodied.descends），这个形成不必体现；于是在 N_rel 之下，珍视这个形成的任一事件，就到达由它而来的关系项的每个活的事件，反之亦然（descent_reaches、ancestry_reaches、arisen_reached）。世代各由前一代给予时，世系使它们连通，共同参与与交互都不连通它们，G0 在那里恰等于种子加 N_rel 加 N_std（Brood.descended）。世系跟着开始作为条件而在走，不跟着生起走：种子从在它休眠时供给它的父代而来（Provisioned.descends），从休眠中醒来不从任何形成而来（Sleeper.no_descent）。两种读法都用到哪个条件就是哪个关系项：把只依存于对方的蜂与花的条件互换，共同参与与交互的连通不变（都不连通），以之为生的连通由有变无（Mutualism.relabel_sustenance）。不用伦理前提，也不用 Lean 公理。 / On the stepwise reading of a web, keep living (active and not undermining) and add to interaction two relations that only a reading with one kind of relatum has. Living on: a formation draws at a step on a relatum and depends on it at a positive need there (LivesOn), and such an event is related to that relatum's events (sustenance). Like interaction it is not free: it needs an actual drawing and a dependence that can fail; under Dependent the relatum an active formation lives on stands at that step (LivesOn.stands), and where that relatum is embodied it is active there (LivesOn.active). It need be neither: an eater can live on a relatum that stands while dormant, living on connecting them where interaction does not (Drowsy.drowsy). It connects a bee and a flower that depend only on each other (Mutualism.apart_sustenance_connected), which neither co-participation nor interaction connects. Under N_rel, valuing an event that lives on a relatum reaches every living event of that relatum, and conversely (living_on_reaches, lived_on_reaches): valuing the fox's eating reaches the hare's living. Descent: a relatum descends from a formation that takes part in a step at which it gives to the relatum and across which the relatum comes to stand (Descends); a give entry of a formation taking no part enters no level and makes no descent (Unrelated.unrelated, Brood.not_descends); and descent relates every event of the one relatum to every event of the other (descent). In a balanced flow in which only active formations give, an embodied relatum that arises descends from another formation active at that step (Embodied.descends), which need not be embodied; so under N_rel, valuing any event of that formation reaches every living event of the relatum descending from it, and conversely (descent_reaches, ancestry_reaches, arisen_reached). Generations each given by the one before are connected by descent and by neither co-participation nor interaction, and G0 there is exactly a seed with N_rel and N_std (Brood.descended). Descent follows coming to stand, not arising: a seed descends from the parent that provisioned it while dormant (Provisioned.descends), and waking from dormancy descends from nothing (Sleeper.no_descent). Both readings use which condition is which relatum: relabelling the conditions of the bee and the flower that depend only on each other, each onto the other, leaves the connection of co-participation and interaction as it was (none) and removes the connection by living on (Mutualism.relabel_sustenance). No ethical premise and no Lean axiom is used.

## 前提与对应 Hypotheses and correspondence

- 一类关系项的读法：条件与形成共用索引，哪个条件就是哪个关系项由共同的索引给出（relabel，见 life-as-condition-of-life）。 / The one-kind reading: conditions and formations share an index, and which condition is which relatum is supplied by the shared index (relabel, see life-as-condition-of-life).
- sustenance 与 descent 是 related 的两种读法，是对应前提：它们是否算作 N_rel 所传递的形成关系，由 Ren 选择。N_rel 本身仍是前提（metaethical-core-characterization）。 / sustenance and descent are two readings of related, correspondence premises: whether they count as formed relations along which N_rel transmits is Ren's choice. N_rel itself remains a premise (metaethical-core-characterization).
- Embodied.descends 与 arisen_reached 需要流平衡依存网、只有活跃形成给予（Acting），以及生起的关系项体现。 / Embodied.descends and arisen_reached need the flow to balance the web, only active formations to give (Acting), and the arising relatum to be embodied.
- LivesOn.stands 需要 Dependent；LivesOn.active 另需以之为生的关系项体现。 / LivesOn.stands needs Dependent; LivesOn.active also needs the relatum lived on to be embodied.

Becoming.Metaethics 把 related 读作形成的关系，列出条件、依存、世系与合作；此前的读法只经由共同的条件相关，life-as-condition-of-life 记下“直接读出体现的估值”为下一步，Mutualism.apart 是其反例：蜂与花都体现、互相依存，却不相关。本结果在一类读法中给出两种直接的关系：以之为生对应条件化与依存，世系对应世系。以之为生要求正需要的依存，所以沿用交互的纪律（连通由活的使用造成）；世系要求参与该步的形成正的给予与开始作为条件而在，所以不由空的给予或不参与者的给予项造成。两种关系的定义都不含体现：这里第一次进入估值的是一类读法的同一对应，不是体现；体现只进入 Embodied.descends 与 arisen_reached 的结论。Ren 的原话是“生生不息 - 一种整体的，不断创造更多生的方向”。在把体现的关系项读作“生”这一属于 Ren 的读法下（整合文档 §23 K6），作者把世系读作原话中两个“生”之间关系的一种形式内容：生起者由给予它的展开而来，并经由世系与整体相关（AI 论证）；这不替代原话，不推出生起是好的，也不决定 Ren 是否采用这些关系。 / Becoming.Metaethics reads related as formed relation and lists conditioning, dependence, descent and cooperation; the earlier readings relate only through a shared condition, life-as-condition-of-life records ‘a valuation reading embodiment directly’ as a next step, and Mutualism.apart is its counterexample: a bee and a flower, both embodied and depending on each other, are unrelated. This result gives two direct relations in the one-kind reading: living on corresponds to conditioning and dependence, descent to descent. Living on requires dependence at a positive need, keeping the discipline of interaction (connection is made by living use); descent requires a positive gift from a formation taking part in the step and coming to stand, so neither empty giving nor the give entry of a formation taking no part makes it. Neither definition mentions embodiment: what first enters the valuation here is the one-kind identification, not embodiment, which enters only the conclusions of Embodied.descends and arisen_reached. Ren's words are “生生不息 - 一种整体的，不断创造更多生的方向” (a whole direction of unceasingly creating more 生). Taking embodied relata as 生, a reading that is Ren's (§23, K6, of the integration note), the author reads descent as one formal content of the relation between the two 生 in those words: what arises comes from the unfolding that gives it, and is related to the whole through descent (an AI argument); it does not replace Ren's words, does not show that arising is good, and does not decide whether Ren adopts these relations.

不含伦理谓词；不改变 living，不改变 C，不推出生起是好的或应当带来新的生起；sustenance 与 descent 是 related 的候选读法，是否采用属于 Ren；世系使两个关系项的所有事件相关，不排定时间；给予的形成不必体现（源给予种子也是世系）；以之为生不问汲取的效果，以之为生的关系项不必体现，也不必活跃（Drowsy）；世系按给予项计，不按净流量：给予又取回同样多的参与者也是祖先，这是又一个读法选择；两种读法都依赖一类读法的同一对应，两类读法检查不到它；只对逐步读法陈述；见证都是最小见证；新名称最终由 Ren 定。 / Contains no ethical predicate; changes neither living nor C, and does not show that arising is good or that new arising ought to be brought about; sustenance and descent are candidate readings of related, and adopting them is Ren's choice; descent relates every event of two relata and does not order them in time; the formation that gives need not be embodied (a source giving to a seed is descent too); living on does not ask about the effect of drawing, and the relatum lived on need be neither embodied nor active (Drowsy); descent counts give entries, not net flow: a formation taking part that gives and takes back as much is still an ancestor, a further choice of reading; both readings depend on the one-kind identification, which the two-kind readings cannot check; stated for the stepwise reading only; the witnesses are minimal; the final choice of names is Ren's.

## 复用与下一增量 Reuse and next delta

Ren 是否采用以之为生与世系作为 N_rel 所传递的关系；排定时间、对效果敏感的以之为生；世系的传递闭包（祖先）与有限步内的世系；整段读法上的同一关系；把世系与 C 联系，即带来新的生起是否使结果更好（Ren）；与 universal_reason 的“新的活的内容”接通。 / Whether Ren adopts living on and descent as relations along which N_rel transmits; an ordered, effect-sensitive living on; the transitive closure of descent (ancestry) and descent within finitely many steps; the same relations for the whole-run reading; relating descent to C, whether bringing about new arising makes an outcome better (Ren); connecting to universal_reason's ‘new living content’.

Aliases / 别名: `Becoming.Web.LivesOn`, `Becoming.Web.sustenance`, `Becoming.Web.LivesOn.active`, `Becoming.Web.living_on_reaches`, `Becoming.Web.lived_on_reaches`, `Becoming.Flow.Descends`, `Becoming.Flow.descent`, `Becoming.Flow.descent_reaches`, `Becoming.Flow.ancestry_reaches`, `Becoming.Web.Embodied.descends`, `Becoming.Web.arisen_reached`, `Becoming.Brood.descended`, `Becoming.Mutualism.apart_sustenance_connected`, `Becoming.Mutualism.relabel_sustenance`
